```yaml
name: Docker Smoke Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
    paths:
      - 'Dockerfile'
      - 'docker-compose*.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/docker-smoke.yml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]
    paths:
      - 'Dockerfile'
      - 'docker-compose*.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/docker-smoke.yml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'tsconfig.json'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docker-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          push: false
          load: true
          tags: arr-dashboard:smoke-test
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      - name: Run container for smoke test
        run: |
          docker run -d \
            --name arr-dashboard-smoke \
            -p 3000:3000 \
            -e TZ=UTC \
            arr-dashboard:smoke-test

      - name: Wait for application to start
        run: |
          echo "Waiting for application to become healthy..."
          timeout 60 bash -c '
            for i in {1..30}; do
              if curl -f http://localhost:3000/health || curl -f http://localhost:3000/; then
                echo "Application is up!"
                exit 0
              fi
              sleep 2
            done
            echo "Application failed to start within timeout"
            exit 1
          '

      - name: Smoke test - Check basic endpoints
        run: |
          echo "Testing basic HTTP endpoints..."
          
          # Test root endpoint
          if ! curl -f -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000/ | grep -q "200"; then
            echo "Root endpoint failed"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Test health endpoint if it exists
          curl -f -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000/health || true
          
          echo "Basic smoke tests passed"

      - name: Smoke test - Check container logs for errors
        run: |
          echo "Checking container logs for critical errors..."
          docker logs arr-dashboard-smoke > /tmp/container-logs.txt
          
          # Check for unhandled promise rejections or fatal errors
          if grep -iE "(fatal error|unhandled exception|process.exit\(1\))" /tmp/container-logs.txt; then
            echo "Critical errors found in logs"
            cat /tmp/container-logs.txt
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "No critical errors found in logs"

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker stop arr-dashboard-smoke || true
          docker rm arr-dashboard-smoke || true
          docker rmi arr-dashboard:smoke-test || true
```
